purpose: Decide how automatic-management discharge capacity should be owned after Q2A policy and Q2B1 managed-band realization pass.

authorities.q1a_exact_control: Q1A-R3/R3L PASS for linear BETAW=1 ContinuousControl + Pump

source_findings: Allocation-controlled TabulatedRatingCurve is natively constrained by its physical Q(h) capacity.
Pinned TabulatedRatingCurve uses PCHIP and does not exactly reproduce the legacy hard-kink linear SWQHR1 law even for nominally linear inputs.
ContinuousControl + Pump can reproduce the frozen linear hard-kink law in the physical layer.
Ribasim allocation does not anticipate ContinuousControl evolution within an allocation interval; it extrapolates the controlled structure flow from the start of the allocation optimization step.

An allocation-controlled Pump has allocation as its control authority; combining exact continuously controlled flow and allocation as two simultaneous flow authorities would violate the one-owner rule.
conclusion: For the pinned release there is no demonstrated single native component mapping that is simultaneously exact to legacy SWQHR1 hard-kink Q(h), dynamically allocation-aware over the allocation interval, and sole flow authority.

RIBASIM_NATIVE_MANAGEMENT.description: Coupler selects accepted WLSTAR; Ribasim LevelDemand represents the band; allocation-controlled TabulatedRatingCurve or other native hydraulic structure provides physical discharge capacity.
changes: exact legacy SWQHR1 interpolation/crest semantics where PCHIP differs
documented legacy SWQHR1/SWQHR2 automatic-capacity asymmetry is not reproduced
RIBASIM_NATIVE_MANAGEMENT.authority_status: CANDIDATE_COUPLED_PROFILE; requires declared approximation/behavior-change envelope for Q(h), not exact legacy-parity claim

LEGACY_QH_PRESERVATION.description: Use exact/source-derived external Q(h) evaluation or ContinuousControl + one-way connector, with management target selected by the coupler.
preserves: declared legacy Q(h) law in qualified domain
limitations: not shown to be dynamically anticipated by Ribasim allocation inside the same allocation interval
requires outer coupling/event semantics or a deliberately short/recomputed management interval if allocation is also required
LEGACY_QH_PRESERVATION.authority_status: RESEARCH_OPTION; not a native exact allocation-aware replacement

recommended_research_scope: For the intended SWAP5-Ribasim coupled architecture, treat Ribasim-native hydraulic realization as the default research target and preserve exact legacy Q(h) only where an application explicitly requires it. Do not make full legacy numerical-parity a hidden retirement prerequisite.
retirement_effect: Q2B2 does not block retirement of SWAP-owned automatic surface-water state/control in a coupled profile if the profile explicitly adopts Ribasim-native hydraulic capacity semantics. It does block any claim of complete numerical/functional parity with all legacy SWQHR1 automatic-discharge behavior.
